baseline_v1.description: Rubric and output format only; no training examples.
baseline_v1.notes: All three applications (FC1-FC3) are scored and compared with human reviews.

multi_examples_v1.description: Baseline prompt plus all four human reviews of the training application (FC3) as calibration examples.
multi_examples_v1.notes: FC3 is training data for this prompt; only FC1 and FC2 are scored and compared with human reviews.

strict_scoring_v1.description: Few-shot prompt plus explicit conservative-scoring instructions.
strict_scoring_v1.notes: FC3 is training data for this prompt; only FC1 and FC2 are scored and compared with human reviews.
